## Triage: p2 · `area:i18n` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-17T22:51Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Fresh read on objectui `main` `8392f74afe`:**
  - the literal "…data source could not be resolved" is still in 12 plugin source files (the card's 16 call sites);
  - the two `@object-ui/react` panel defaults are still English (`ElementDataSourceGate.tsx:531`, `:743`).
- **Grade p2,** the family's grade (objectui#12889, #12910). After PR #12919, one zh-CN page mixes languages by block. The panel shows only when a `dataSource.view` names no view, an authoring error, so it holds no release.
- **Scope = the card's Expected:**
  - one key per block kind in PR #12919's `element.KIND.sourceUnresolved` shape, in all ten packs;
  - the `@object-ui/react` defaults read it too;
  - one pin per family, and the English pin in `ListView.sharedGate.test.tsx` is edited deliberately.
  - ⛔ No new panel component.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. It is one PR unless the claim measures the 12 plugins as too wide, in which case it splits by plugin.

Responsibility: (1) objectui's own code: every data-bound plugin block titles its unresolvable-view panel with an English literal | (2) no platform path covers it: the titles are renderer literals, not spec or pack text | (3) every page viewer in a non-English locale who meets a block whose `dataSource.view` names no view; after PR #12919 the same page mixes languages by block

Posted by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`) verbatim from the cloud session's final message of its second round, because a cloud session cannot comment from its container. The seat wrote `pr` as the number of the draft PR it opened, #12927 (the dev wrote its URL).

**The seat's answers:**
- **Round 1 (head `b683b7d`, report in the session, opened as PR #12927):**
  - Open question 1 (which translation hook): **A**, `@object-ui/i18n`'s `useObjectTranslation` with the en value as `defaultValue` in every shell. It is the PR #12919 and `ElementDataSourceGate` pattern, and `check:i18n-keys` holds each default to the pack.
  - Open question 2 (`plugin-map` has no `@object-ui/i18n` dependency): **(c)**, read the hook through `@object-ui/react`'s existing re-export, as `useGanttTranslation` does. It keeps the map's title specific and moves no manifest or lockfile.
  - Open question 3 (names for the two React defaults): **`element.component.sourceUnresolved` / `element.component.noDataSource`**, accepted.
- **The rework (this round, head `36bfc88`):** the seat sent back one fold-in, because this card closes the family: `record-related-list.tsx:816`'s English parent-read `errorTitle` was the last English `errorTitle` literal in `packages/*/src`. It now reads `element.relatedList.parentUnreadable`, and the broad grep prints nothing outside tests. The pin's placement beside the existing parent-read pins (the deviation) is accepted.
- **Findings:** `plugin-map`'s English Edit / Delete popup buttons have no reach (no producer passes `onEdit` / `onDelete` to `ObjectMap`); Acceptance notes only, not filed.
- **The seat read the diff:** 43 files, all on the claimed surface. The larger hunks in `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-charts` and `plugin-form` are arrow components turned into block bodies so they can call the hook; the gate props and children are unchanged. CI on `b683b7d` was 33 success and 3 skipped, and the console budget reads 3153.6 KB on both heads.
- **Next:** CI on `36bfc88`, then the ACCEPT.

- **Verified by content:** the merge commit's own diff equals the PR's diff from `35244b6379` to the reviewed head `36bfc88`, changed line for changed line in each of the 44 files (+1167/−100).
- **Positive control at the merge commit:** `ElementDataSourcePanels.titleDefault-12920.test.tsx` is present, and no `errorTitle="…"` literal is left in `packages/*/src` outside tests. At the parent `35244b6379` the pin is absent and there are 17.
- **Card:** closed `completed` by `Fixes #12920`. Every data-bound block, and `record:related_list`'s parent-read panel, titles its data-source panel in the page's language. The two `@object-ui/react` panel defaults read the bundle when no title is passed, and an authored title still wins. This note precedes the strip of `pm:dispatched`, and the cloud session is archived.
- **Next, outside this card:** none filed. `plugin-map`'s English Edit / Delete popup buttons have no producer today and stay an Acceptance note.
